repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
fired := false
if (fired == true) {
wait until((#LR_MB).multiButton_button2 != "pushed")
fired = false
}
wait until((#LR_MB).multiButton_button2 == "pushed")
all(#WindowCovering).windowCovering_upOrOpen()
fired = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a rising-edge wait on Button2 followed by an action. The candidate polls the condition at the start of the body; since the input was already 'pushed' at t=0, the rising edge had already passed before the first iteration's check at t=0, causing the wait to be skipped and the action never to fire. The candidate must block until the rising edge occurs.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the periodic polling `if` with the standard rising-edge state machine: persist `fired`, block until the condition becomes false if already fired, then block until it becomes true, execute the action, and mark fired.
